name: NSO official statistics (attribution required)
notes: Nepal's National Statistics Office publishes census results with the notice "Copyright (c) National Statistics Office 2023. All rights reserved." and no open-licence grant. This entry records a deliberate project decision, not an inference: these are official state statistics published for public use, we republish aggregates only and never microdata, and every figure names NSO and links to source. Revisit if NSO publishes explicit terms.
